A terrestrial '''planet''' at one point [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a dying [[Star/Legends|star]]. The red-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] known as the [[Qixoni crystal/Legends|Qixoni crystals]] were formed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], where they were warmed by the dying sun. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] before<ref name="KOTOR2" /> [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', which includes an appearance of the [[Qixoni crystal/Legends|Qixoni crystals]], to [[3951 BBY]].</ref> some of the earliest [[Jedi/Legends|members]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] visited the planet, where they discovered the Qixoni crystals. The Jedi used the red [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]] as powerful [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|focusing crystals]] in their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] weapons.<ref name="KOTOR2" />

However, only a handful of the Qixoni crystals were obtained before the planet's star exploded as a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]], destroying the planet and rendering the remaining crystals exceedingly rare.<ref name="KOTOR2" /> Eventually, it was said that the crystals obtained on the planet had instead been forged in the heart of the supernova,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|56|qixoni crystal}}</ref> and the crystals came to share their name with the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Qixoni Nebula/Legends|Qixoni Nebula]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The planet was first mentioned in the [[2004]] [[Obsidian Entertainment]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''.<ref name="KOTOR2" />
